notes.title: Devlog - New Flavors on the Horizon
notes.content:
[h3][b]🐾 Introduction[/b][/h3][p]The ship keeps sailing through open waters, and the crew never stops exploring the nearby islands. This time we’ve come across something that could change the rhythm of survival – fish that can be used as food, exotic animals hidden in containers carried aboard the ship, and now also a bird system. Birds can be hunted for supplies, and if the crew finds their nests, eggs can be collected as an additional food source.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]⚙️ [b]New Systems onboard[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a [b]fish system[/b] – they can be caught around islands and used as food.
[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented a [b]bird system[/b] – players can hunt birds or gather eggs from nests they discover.
[/p][/*][*][p]Basic [b]interactions and behaviors[/b] are in place – animals can be collected, observed, or used as resources.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/6c455bc2bc04f8b7a4f198d786d1c986f3dc803c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]🐾 What we’re focusing on now[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Testing [b]food balance[/b] – how many fish, birds, or eggs are needed, and what effects exotic animals bring.
[/p][/*][*][p]Checking how these new resources affect the [b]overall survival strategy[/b].[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/1017362df298ea4a2bf427d78a989edb6bf57efe.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][h3][b]🌊 Next steps[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Expanding the [b]exotic animal[/b] system – adding special effects or risks.
[/p][/*][*][p]Refining the [b]bird system[/b] – different bird types and nest locations.
[/p][/*][*][p]Integrating all new resources with the daily challenges on the ship.
[/p][/*][*][p]Testing [b]island exploration[/b] with [b]fishing[/b], [b]bird hunting[/b], and [b]animal discovery[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/1ae522eeae1be61eb26f23478c796c48f444e33f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🤖 AI Improvements[/h3][p]We’ve also worked on enhancing [b]AI behavior[/b].
The fixes are already available in the [b]demo version[/b], so you can try them out right now![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]🚀 What’s next[/b][/h3][p]The crew won’t just stop at food sources – in the next update we’ll tease something much more challenging that could shake up survival on the ship. Stay tuned.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 🚢 Update: Fixes, Improvements & What’s Next
notes.content:
[h2][b][i]Hey Castaways![/i][/b][/h2][p]Over the last weeks you’ve been sending us tons of valuable feedback – and today many of those fixes have landed in [i]30 Days on Ship[/i]! This update focuses on the most requested improvements that will make survival on board smoother, clearer, and more immersive.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]✅ What’s Fixed & Improved[/h2][p]Here’s a quick rundown of the changes that made it in:[/p][list][*][p]⚙️ [b]Optimization & Comfort[/b] – implemented TSR & DLSS for upscaling, framegen and improved anti-aliasing. No more ghosting during quick camera moves.[/p][/*][*][p]📘 [b]Early Game Path (Tutorial)[/b] – clearer first steps and survival guidance.[/p][/*][*][p]🌐 [b]Multiplayer[/b] – improved flow for hosting/joining games; less confusion, smoother co-op.[/p][/*][*][p]💾 [b]Save System[/b] – UI updated so it’s clear how to save and load progress.[/p][/*][*][p]📖 [b]Mission Log[/b] – first version added to help track objectives.[/p][/*][*][p]🖥️ [b]UI Improvements[/b] – cleaner, more intuitive interface across the board.[/p][/*][*][p]🎵 [b]Sounds[/b] – missing effects filled in; ambience and interactions now feel more alive.[/p][/*][*][p]🕹️ [b]Animations[/b] – polishing transitions and fixing reported glitches.[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 [b]Controller Support[/b] – better mapping and UI navigation for gamepads.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🔮 What’s Next[/h2][p]With these fixes in place, we’re moving on to [b]AI improvements[/b] – one of the most requested features.
If all goes well, we’re planning another update to the demo [b]later this month[/b], bringing even more of your top suggestions into the game.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing, testing, and sending us your thoughts. Every report helps us make [i]30 Days on Ship[/i] a better survival experience. Keep the feedback coming – and stay tuned for the next update![/p]

notes.title: Community Feedback & What We’re Working On
notes.content:
[h1][i][b]Hey Castaways![/b][/i][/h1][p][/p][p]Thank you for all the feedback you’ve been sharing – it’s incredibly valuable for us. In this devlog, we want to highlight the key issues you’ve reported and how we’re addressing them. Step by step, your input is helping shape [i]30 Days on Ship[/i] into a better survival experience.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]⚙️ Optimization & Player Comfort[/h2][p]One of the most common reports has been performance drops and motion discomfort during fast movements.
We’re implementing [b]TSR[/b] and [b]DLSS[/b] – technologies that bring upscaling, frame generation, and improved anti-aliasing. The current solution sometimes left ghosting during rapid motion – and that’s exactly what we’re fixing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/46667cbd836c2d0ceea8eb44716a3299605a3c99.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]📘 Early Game Path (Tutorial)[/h2][p]We know the beginning of the game can feel unclear and unintuitive. We’re improving the tutorial to guide players step by step through the core survival mechanics – without overwhelming you, but making sure you know what to do to stay alive.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🎮 Controller Support[/h2][p]We’ve seen many requests for better controller support. Right now, navigation and gameplay are primarily tuned for keyboard & mouse, but we’re working on improving controller mapping and UI navigation so that playing with a gamepad feels smooth and natural. This will take time, but it’s already on our roadmap.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🌐 Multiplayer[/h2][p]Many players have reported issues with multiplayer sessions. After investigating, we found the main culprit to be [b]confusing UI[/b], making it hard to host or join games. We’re redesigning this flow to make co-op play smoother and more reliable.[/p][p]
Multiplayer tutorial: [url="https://discord.com/channels/1209463859555995669/1225388582227939359/1408365418258628659"]https://discord.com/channels/1209463859555995669/1225388582227939359/1408365418258628659[/url][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]💾 Save Game[/h2][p]Some players didn’t even realize the game already has a save system. That tells us the feature isn’t visible or intuitive enough. We’ll be updating the UI to make saving and loading progress much clearer.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]📖 Mission Log[/h2][p]A frequent request – and we hear you! A [b]Mission Log[/b] will be added at a later stage of the demo. This will help you track objectives and progress without having to rely on memory or guesswork.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/85b448c5ee35e1ff0db820c709f3f88d7a7075ba.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🖥️ UI Improvements[/h2][p]We’ve received a lot of feedback that the current UI is not very intuitive or informative. We’re redesigning elements to improve readability and make sure players can quickly understand what’s happening on screen.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🎵 Missing Sounds[/h2][p]Often reported as bugs, missing sounds are something we’re actively working on. Ambient effects, interactions, combat sounds – all of these are being filled in to make the ship feel more alive and immersive.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🕹️ Animations[/h2][p]While not as critical as optimization or UI, some animations looked unnatural or were glitching. We’re going through reported cases and fixing them to ensure smoother, more natural motion across characters and the environment.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/9e209748d82bc1be4f6d1aac0441e6944511ede0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Wrap-Up[/h3][p]Every point above comes directly from your feedback – and every single one is already in our development plan. Our focus right now is on [b]optimization, tutorial improvements, and multiplayer[/b], but UI, sound, animations, and the mission log are all on their way too.[/p][p]Together, we’re making [i]30 Days on Ship[/i] a stronger survival experience – thank you for being part of it![/p]

notes.title: Playtest Update And On the Horizon: Full Version in the Works
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey Castaways![/b][/h2][p]It’s time for a big update — and a look at what’s ahead.
We’ve just rolled out [b]a new content patch for the playtest[/b], and at the same time, we’re officially shifting gears into [b]full production of the complete version[/b] of [i]30 Days on Ship[/i]. Let’s dive into both.

👉 [b]We assumed we’re not far from opening up a public demo[/b], but we want to make sure it’s solid and meaningful when it lands.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/d58dda9a7610e17730bb0a7870631437c6022679.gif"][/img][/h3][h3]🔄 [b]Playtest Update: Now With Swimming and... Something Below[/b][/h3][p]Last week, we sent out [b]50,000 new invites[/b] to the playtest — bringing the total number of participants to [b]over 100,000 players[/b] and we want more!
This is a huge milestone for us. Thanks to your feedback, bug reports, and hardware testing, the game is now running [b]more stable than ever[/b], with consistent performance across most systems.[/p][p]To celebrate that progress (and to test new mechanics in action), we’ve added a small but meaningful update to the current build:[/p][p]🌊 [b]Swimming is now available[/b]
You can finally get off the ship and into the water. Exploring the flooded surroundings opens up new tactical options — and new dangers.[/p][p]🦈 [b]Meet your first aquatic enemy: the Shark[/b]
It’s fast. It’s deadly. And it’s always lurking nearby. Consider this your first lesson in underwater survival.[/p][p]📦 [b]Sunken container: risk vs reward[/b]
We’ve placed a single locked container underwater. It might hold something useful — if you can get to it and back without becoming dinner.[/p][p]This is just a taste of what underwater exploration will feel like in the full version — eerie, resourceful, and filled with tension.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/1d034d86cfacfa713cd23d302e0d4be65161dbf9.gif"][/img][/p][h3]🚧 [b]Full Version: Production Is Underway[/b][/h3][p]With the playtest running well, our focus has now fully shifted to building out the complete version of the game. That means deeper systems, broader exploration, and more threats and stories to uncover.[/p][p]Here’s what we’re actively working on:[/p][p]🚗 [b]Vehicles[/b]
Yep. Drivable vehicles are coming. Whether it’s hauling loot across long distances, reaching off-ship locations, or just speeding through hostile zones — vehicles will become a vital part of survival.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/092298824f8153bf6dc669b548f821b8426b455e.gif"][/img][/p][p]🧟 [b]New Enemies & AI Behavior[/b]
We’re designing more enemy types with varied behaviors — patrols, ambushes, smart reactions. Expect to be surprised, challenged, and maybe even hunted.[/p][p]🌊 [b]Marine Life[/b]
The ocean is about to come alive. Some creatures might help you. Most… probably won’t. Underwater exploration will get more intense — and more rewarding.[/p][p]🏝️ [b]More Islands & Off-Ship Expeditions[/b]
The wreck isn’t the only thing left in the world. We’re working on distant islands and isolated points of interest that reward players willing to take the risk — and have the tools to return.[/p][p]🔧 [b]Crafting, Upgrades, and Base Systems[/b]
We’re expanding the core survival loop with deeper crafting, workbench upgrades, structural improvements, and more flexible ways to build and defend your base.[/p][p]📖 [b]Narrative & Worldbuilding[/b]
Expect more story threads, notes, recordings, and environmental storytelling as we flesh out the mystery of what happened — and what’s still out there.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/cf7a4f84b58db46674812d60a26f8b88f4c8909c.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you again to everyone who joined the playtest, gave feedback, or added [i]30 Days on Ship[/i] to their wishlist. Your support genuinely helps shape the future of the game.[/p][p]We’ll be back soon with more updates, including a sneak peek at upcoming features. Until then…[/p][p]Stay dry. Or don’t. 🦈[/p][p]📌 Wishlist [i]30 Days on Ship[/i] on Steam[/p]

notes.title: The Ship Expands
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey Castaways![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]The past few weeks have been intense – we’ve been hard at work expanding the world of the game. Until now, most of your time has been spent in the familiar, starting zone of the ship — the place where you learn to survive and explore. But that’s about to change.[/p][p]Today, we’re showing you the first locations that lie beyond the starting area — environments we’re preparing for the full release of the game.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]What’s New?[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/57daea512b596ffe1c64047afb5a52eb6ae4d360.gif"][/img][/p][p]🛏️ Residential Segment[/p][p]At first glance — calm and empty.
But the longer you stay here, the more unsettling it becomes.
Locked doors, rushed notes, signs of panic.
Some passages require access codes. Others can be forced open...
—but that might attract something that shouldn’t be moving at all.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/024da646f52bae55b4eec4a3bb8125d47dddebe3.gif"][/img][/p][p]📦 Lower Cargo Module[/p][p]A storage zone taken over by a hostile group.
This isn’t just a technical space anymore — it’s a base.
Traps. Barriers. Patrols.
The signal in this area is jammed.
You can sneak around them. You can take them out.
But you’ll need a plan.
Inside: rare resources you won’t find anywhere else.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/53d42726aab8b0da156e08d03ad5a21e17e12a09.gif"][/img][/p][p]🌊 Islands Around the Ship[/p][p]Small, isolated islets drifting near the wreck.
Scattered containers — some sealed, some torn apart by time.
Sometimes junk. Sometimes life-saving gear.
Perfect for a quick run — if you’ve got a way back.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Let us know what you think!
More to come soon — we’re just getting started. 👀[/p]

notes.title: Danger Comes in All Shapes — Even Fluffy…
notes.content:
[h1][b]📦 Danger Comes in All Shapes — Even Fluffy… 🐾[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Ahoy Survivors! 🧐[/b][/h3]  
The ship may look abandoned, but some containers hold more than rusted scrap.  
As we continue working on *30 Days on Ship*, we’re introducing [b]animal containers[/b] — sealed units still echoing with life from the past…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/de2450b9b9fcb43299c7cc76bf36c7b79ec3f899.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🐾 What’s Inside the Containers?[/h2]

Each themed container holds different wildlife. Some may be harmless… others, not so much:

[list]
[*]🐑 [b]FARM[/b] – Sheep, rabbits, and chickens once traveled here. Some still remain.
[*]🦎 [b]DESERT[/b] – Be careful — the Komodo Dragon doesn’t like visitors.
[*]🐆 [b]SAVANNAH[/b] – A leopard watches from the shadows.
[*]🦀 [b]CRABS[/b] – If it clicks, it lives. These decks are theirs now.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/ad69805defbfc3f02370b9b5da7e7f171022d230.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]⚠️ How It Changes Exploration[/h2]

Animal containers bring [b]life and threat[/b] to the ship:  
[list]
[*]Some creatures flee when spotted  
[*]Others defend their space  
[*]All react to your presence
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/bd35c43deaf058078e3e1e51417ff99cddea0b53.jpg[/img]
They can become a [b]source of food[/b], a [b]sudden danger[/b], or an [i]unexpected companion[/i].  
Each container deepens the mystery — [i]what was this vessel really transporting?[/i]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]💬 Tell Us What You Think![/h2]  
Do you like this twist? Got theories about the cargo? Drop your thoughts in the comments!

notes.title: DANGER!
notes.content:
[h1][b]🏴‍☠️ NEW PIRATES ON BOARD! ⚔️[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/714d55231b6f0fb7031654cb5a3a7efdc22235ef.gif[/img]
[b][h3]Ahoy, survivors! 🌊[/h3][/b]
The open sea is never truly safe, and as we continue developing 30 Days on Ship, we’ve expanded the pirate threat by introducing three new pirate characters. Each brings a fresh challenge to encounters, making raids feel more intense. They’re not just here to look around—expect more aggressive looting, destruction, and pursuit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/e7ef4ea8c77afd643ac2ee36c832d4b100a54a57.jpg[/img]

[h3]WHAT’S NEW?[/h3]
Pirate behavior is evolving to add more variety to encounters, making raids feel less predictable. Here’s what we’ve been working on so far:
[list]
[*] 🏴‍☠️ Three new pirate characters – Each with different looks.
[*] ⚔️ Chasing & Searching – Pirates now react better to spotting players and will look around if they lose track of their target.
[*] 🛠️ Attacking Built Structures – They can destroy player-built objects, so defenses won’t last forever!
[*] 📦 Scavenging for Items – Left something behind? Pirates will now pick up abandoned loot.
[*] 🎯 Ranged Combat – Some pirates carry firearms, making long-distance encounters riskier.
[*] 🐺 Attacking Wildlife – It’s not just players in danger—pirates will go after animals, too.
[*] 🧗 Climbing & Boarding – They can now use ladders, meaning they can reach new areas.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/ee93f1d770ea1e052b187c3c883ceb61b2fdf3ef.jpg[/img]
[h1]HOW THIS CHANGES SURVIVAL[/h1]
Pirate encounters will be a bigger part of the survival loop. While they’re still not the smartest foes, their improved behaviors and new characters make defending your ship a greater challenge. You’ll need to think about where you build, what you leave behind, and how you handle confrontations.

What would be your strategy? Strengthen defenses, stay hidden, or try to fight back? Let us know!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/1e440bfb484e75c46d55af39c864c3af796e50fa.jpg[/img]
🌊 The ocean is getting more dangerous. Stay prepared. 🌊

💬 Join the discussion and share your thoughts in the comments!
⭐ Don’t forget to wishlist and follow 30 Days on Ship to stay updated!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2800370/30_Days_on_Ship/

notes.title: Development Update! – CO-OP, Combat, Crafting and more....
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey, Castaways!🌊[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/ff94e2a43d951418426cad00cd7aa0f9f0315b2f.png[/img]

[b]We’ve got some exciting news for you!🎉 Thanks to your suggestions and continuous support, we’re thrilled to announce several major updates coming to 30 Days on Ship soon. Let’s dive in!🏊‍♂️[/b]

[h2][b]CO-OP Mode - Your Requests Have Been Heard!⚓[/b][/h2]
[b]You asked for more interaction, and we listened![/b] We’re excited to share that 30 Days on Ship will feature 4-player co-op mode. Team up with up to three other players, manage your resources, and work as a crew to survive the full 30-day journey. Cooperation will be crucial—every task, from repairing the ship to rationing supplies, will require careful planning and teamwork.
[previewyoutube=d1MlZHud84w;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]We're still fine-tuning the co-op experience to ensure it’s both engaging and immersive, so stay tuned for more updates as we move forward with development![/i]

[h3][b]Expanded Crafting – More Depth, More Possibilities 🛠️[/b][/h3]
We're refining and expanding the crafting system to make it more intuitive and rewarding. New tools, items, and survival gear will give you more options to adapt to the challenges at sea. We're focusing on balancing and polishing the mechanics to ensure crafting feels both engaging and essential to your journey.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/25a12a309e13da64cc1190018466989ac1c2bcf3.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Enhanced Combat – New Challenges Await ⚔️[/b][/h3]
Survival at sea isn’t just about managing resources—it’s also about facing the dangers that lurk beyond the waves. We’ve been refining the combat system to make encounters more dynamic and engaging. From defending against pirate attacks to fending off wildlife, every fight will require strategy and skill. [b]Watch out for your friends - friendly fire is on![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/6a8022467bb23d8da7163011372403c6f6696cec.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Playtests in February - Join Us!📝🎮[/b][/h3]
Last but not least - playtests are coming this February! 📅 This is your chance to experience the new features firsthand and share your feedback with us.💬 Keep an eye on our social media channels and sign up for the playtests to be among the first survivors to test them out!🚀

[h3][b]That’s all for now! Thank you for your continued support - we can’t wait for you to try these new features. Stay tuned for more updates!🧭[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]See you on board![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Time to fight back! Closer look at MELEE
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Castaways![/b][/h1]
In today’s devlog, we’re diving into the [b]melee weapon system in 30 Days on Ship.[/b] These weapons not only enhance combat options but also add depth to how you interact with the world around you. Each weapon has unique traits, damage potential, and versatility, making your choice of equipment critical for survival.
[h3][i]Additional information what else - at the very bottom![/i][/h3]

[previewyoutube=a-SJm3QRRWo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Melee Weapons Overview[/b][/h3]
[i]Here’s a look at the melee weapons available in the game:[/i]

[h3][b]Axe[/b] – A powerful weapon for dealing with enemies and breaking obstacles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/127f8a8a9da670e468e5894e9794768bf6956b1f.gif[/img]

[b]Guitar Machete[/b] – A creative and deadly combination that’s both functional and visually striking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/59a7ce3266d2d8c5691985513a85bdc2e7db3436.gif[/img]

[b]Machete[/b] – A classic survival weapon, perfect for quick, precise attacks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/e8934098772034fff5736107fb5ab4912738bcda.gif[/img]

[b]Sledge Hammer[/b] – Heavy and devastating, great for delivering crushing blows.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/535160ed13652b07e89c8b0eeaf1859de03f2cfd.gif[/img]

[b]Spear[/b] – Excellent for keeping enemies at bay with long-reaching attacks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/3215778235c83414d060bd2ed78e7d1e9418b068.gif[/img]

[b]Crowbar[/b] – A versatile tool for prying open containers and delivering solid strikes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/494e30d5191f6d576249455717ee87c52859a7a4.gif[/img]

[b]Screwdriver[/b] – Precise and deadly, capable of both repairs and piercing attacks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/05bfe8731909a0d209ddd0304ea5030b7bf06618.gif[/img]

[b]Fishing Rod[/b] – Primarily for fishing but can be repurposed to pack a punch in emergencies.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/5eda0ab9794146950c838c6760707e315dcda230.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Varied Damage and Utility[/b][/h2]
[i]Each weapon offers different damage outputs and uses, such as:[/i]

[b]Lightweight tools[/b], like the screwdriver, allow for faster attacks but deal less damage.

[b]Heavier weapons[/b], like the sledge hammer, hit hard but require more effort to wield effectively.

[b]Dual-purpose tools[/b], like the crowbar and fishing rod, add strategic flexibility to your arsenal.

[h3]Melee weapons in 30 Days on Ship are not just for combat - they're essential tools for survival. Which weapon do you think will be your favorite? Let us know in the comments, and feel free to share your ideas for new melee tools![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/7e30df35d931d9ece8603cdf7848f87f04da1967.png[/img]

[h1][b]And on top of that,[/b][/h1] [h3]we have completed the closed beta playtest phase.
[i]Your feedback we have received, which includes what you like and the bugs our testers found - the bugs are already being addressed![/i]

[b]We are working on optimization and on a version of the game for open playtests![/b]

We are correcting every detail for you and correcting every bug that was found, so that you can enjoy it![/h3]

[h2][b]See you on the open ocean! 🌊[/b][/h2]

notes.title: Movement on the Ship - Climbing, Escaping!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, Castaways!⚓️[/b][/h1]

[b]This time, we want to tell you all about how moving around the ship will look. Get ready for a mix of adventure, parkour, and… danger!💀[/b]

There’s no room for boredom on this wreck. In addition to classic exploration, you’ll face challenges that will fill each step with adrenaline and strategic thinking🏴‍☠️
[previewyoutube=gfVJThKlqg0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]What’s in Store for You?[/b][/h3]

[b]Jumping on Containers[/b] – In some areas, you’ll have to jump across containers to reach hard-to-reach spots. Sometimes, to get to treasure or rare items, you’ll need to climb to the top of a container stack! Just be careful with your balance and agility – some paths will require the skills of a true acrobat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/4cb4ba0a61016746079961fe67a29030f9fd5dd1.gif[/img]

[b]Escaping Animals and Pirates[/b] – The wreck is home to various wild animals, and sometimes even hostile pirates. While traversing the ship, you’ll occasionally need to make a quick escape or find a shortcut to avoid danger. It’s light parkour where every second counts!

[b]Dark and Narrow Passages[/b] – Some areas on the ship will force you through tight, dark corridors. You’ll need to move carefully, as these places hold plenty of surprises – from aggressive animals to lurking pirates. It’ll be a true test of courage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/9f0e1021f1ccdf649b6859b24b2b9a79f11df4af.gif[/img]

[h3][b]We’d Love to Hear Your Thoughts![/b][/h3]
[b]Survivors, tell us what you think about this mix of parkour, exploration! Every step on the ship can be an adventure in itself. Do you like this vision full of action and challenges?[/b]

notes.title: Below Deck – The Hidden Depths of the Ship
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, survivors![/b][/h1]

[b]Today, we’re taking you below deck to explore the darker, more challenging parts of the ship. Ready to dive into the depths?[/b]⚓️
When you descend into the belly of the wreck, you’ll find a maze of tunnels, remnants of destroyed sections, and blocked pathways that only the brave (or the trained) should even think about navigating. [b]This part of the ship is a dangerous labyrinth, filled with collapsed sections, twisted pipes, and places that feel entirely off-limits.[/b]
[previewyoutube=ILZqd_zttrw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Here’s what to expect:[/b][/h3]

[b]Collapsed Pathways and Fallen Debris[/b] – Parts of the ship are badly damaged, with corridors filled with rubble, broken metal, and blocked routes. You may need to rethink your path or find another way around these challenging obstacles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/339903bb0d4de7a695319d847a829757bc3a5d68.gif[/img]

[b]Restricted Access Zones[/b] – There are areas below deck that should only be accessed by trained personnel, but desperate times call for desperate measures. Some rooms and tunnels are blocked by barriers or doors that can only be unlocked from the other side or require specific tools to open.🪓
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/c2545cfb5504e5a443431b754a5da70ce299045f.gif[/img]

[b]Twisting Pipes and Tight Spaces[/b] – Navigating below deck means maneuvering through tight, winding spaces filled with pipes and machinery. This environment is far from comfortable, and every turn brings new risks. You’ll need to be alert and ready for anything!

[b]Secret Tools and Skills Needed[/b] – Some sections of the wreck will require you to locate specific tools to gain access. These tools might be hidden somewhere on the ship, so exploring will be essential.🔧

[h3][b]Are you excited to venture below deck? Survivors, let us know what you think of these dark, hidden passages! This is a place that only the bravest will conquer – and we’re eager to hear how you feel about this added challenge![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Physical Audio – Every Sound Tell a Story...
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, survivors![/b][/h1]
[b]Today, we’re sharing a key part of our work on 30 Days on Ship: the immersive audio of the items you encounter.[/b]🎧 From the containers you open to the objects you handle, each has a unique sound that enhances the atmosphere and adds depth to your survival experience.🎶

[b]The ship is filled with distinct, ambient sounds, but it's the specific sounds of items found in containers that add a layer of realism and strategy.[/b] Each item—whether it's a metal tool, a glass bottle, or a piece of wood—creates its own noise when picked up, dropped, or moved. These sounds aren’t just for show; they could influence your survival. Rummaging too noisily through a container might reveal your position, adding a strategic element to how you handle objects on the ship.🎶
[previewyoutube=1b_YQe6bfuM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Here’s what to keep an ear out for:[/b][/h3]

[b]Distinct Sounds of Container Finds[/b]📣 – When searching through containers, every item responds with its own sound: metal clinks, glass rattles, and wood thuds. The weight and material of each object come through in the audio, letting you identify them just by sound. But be careful—a noisy search can quickly attract unwanted attention, so think twice before shifting items around carelessly.🎵

[b]Footsteps and Movement[/b]📣 – Each step echoes differently depending on the ship's surface. Metal, wood, and rusted pathways all add their own tone to your movements. Move too quickly, and you might give yourself away. But sometimes a loud rush is your only option to escape danger.

[b]Doors and Corridors[/b]📣 – Every door has its own unique creak, and certain echoes carry farther in the ship’s metal corridors. When opening or closing doors, the noise can either aid or hinder you, depending on the situation.

[h3][b]The Sound of Survival:[/b][/h3]
On this ship, sound is as important as sight. From handling objects carefully to choosing when to make a run for it, every action has an audio consequence. We hope you find yourself fully immersed in this audio-driven experience! Let us know how the sounds shape your journey, and feel free to ask questions or share your thoughts on how audio influences your survival strategy!

notes.title: Random Containers Loot
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, survivors![/h1]

[b]We’ve got some exciting news for you! 🎉[/b]

Based on your feedback in recent surveys, we’re thrilled to introduce one of the most requested features: fully randomized container contents. Thank you for your suggestions – they’ve shaped this new addition to the game!

[b]Now, every time you embark on your journey aboard the wrecked ship, each container will be a surprise.[/b] The objects you find will vary with each playthrough. You may encounter rare tools or just common supplies, but you’ll never know what to expect!

[previewyoutube=qIMi334spuI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]What’s Changing?[/b][/h2]
[b]Randomized Container Contents[/b] – With each new game, the items inside the containers are randomly generated. No container will ever be the same, which means exploring the ship will feel like a fresh challenge every time. You might come across essential tools – or find nothing but junk! 🍀 [b]Luck will play a big role.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/942a1caaacec726ae91dee9e23fc39317d23201f.gif[/img]

[b]Varied Quantities[/b] – It’s not just the type of items, but also the amount that will be random. Sometimes, you’ll discover a container packed with resources, while other times, only a few scraps. This unpredictability will keep every playthrough unique, requiring a new survival strategy each time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/9307e9bf0b8c34eca1658922cb1f9d6241c1fbab.gif[/img]

[b]Dynamic Exploration[/b] – This added randomness brings a new layer of mystery. Even veteran players will find themselves adapting to new discoveries and adjusting their survival strategies based on what they manage to find. After all, you never know what’s waiting behind the next container door! 🔍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/39a3c2ac7d5fa74068b506d573cea91af381bdee.gif[/img]

[b]“Funny Containers”[/b] – Here’s our little gift for you – special containers packed with amusing, sometimes eccentric items curated by us, the developers! While these surprise items might not always be useful, they’ll certainly bring a smile to your face. 🎁 [b]We’re placing these fun containers randomly, so you’ll never know where to find the next quirky surprise.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/10129a23bdbb68d52fd88cfd85675da5f5a488b1.gif[/img]

[b]What Do You Want to See in “Funny Containers”?[/b]
Your feedback has always been our top priority, so we’d love to hear your ideas for more “Funny Containers”! Maybe you have thoughts on special contents, amusing descriptions, or unique, funny items you’d like us to add. [b]Share your ideas – who knows, maybe your suggestion will become part of the adventure![/b]

[h3][b]Let’s make each adventure unforgettable. Thanks again for helping us shape this game – we’re building an experience we all want to play![/b][/h3]
